test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 17 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two trains that are 125 metres and 99 metres in length, respectively, are running in opposite directions at the speeds of 40 km/h and 32 km/h, respectively. In how much time will they be completely clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of trains = 125 m and 99 m 

Speed of trains = 40 km/h and 32 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = (Distance)/(Time)

1 km/h = **(5)/(18)** m/s

**Calculations:**

Total distance travelled by both the trains = 125 + 99 = 224 m

Total speed of both the trains (km/h) = 40 + 32 = 72 m 

⇒ Total speed of both the trains (m/s) = 72 × (5)/(18)

⇒ Total speed of both the trains (m/s) = 20

Time taken = (Total Distance)/(Total Speed)

⇒ Time taken = (224)/(20)

⇒ Time taken = 11.2 s

**∴ The time taken is 11.2 seconds.**
